title: What is Diversity?
text: Diversity means variety. Biodiversity is the variety of living things. But variety exists at different scales - from differences in DNA to differences in entire ecosystems.

title: Three Scales of Variety
text: Think small to large: GENETIC diversity (differences in genes within a species), SPECIES diversity (number of different species), and ECOSYSTEM diversity (variety of different habitats like forests, grasslands, wetlands).
